message_preview: I am feeling extremely overwhelmed by my upcoming deadlines. I don't know where to start.
I just feel so exhausted today. Everything seems like a massive effort.
I have that presentation later today. My heart is racing and my palms are sweating.
The presentation went surprisingly well. I'm so glad it's finally over.
My coworker took credit for the project we've been working on. I'm furious right now.
I took your advice and went for a long walk. I feel much more centered now.
I'm really torn about this new job offer. It pays more but the hours are terrible.
After writing out the pros and cons, I think I have a clear path forward. I feel good about it.
Just checking in today. Nothing major going on, just a regular morning.
Had dinner with my family tonight. It's nice to just be around people who care.
I started reading that book you suggested about mindfulness. It's actually really interesting.
I hit a new personal best at the gym today! I feel so energetic and proud.
Doing my morning breathing exercises. Starting the day feeling very peaceful.
Looking back at my week, I handled stress much better than I used to. Thanks for being here.
